proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d
  constructor
  · push_cast
    linear_combination (b : ℂ) * d * Complex.I_sq
  · intro h
    have hn : c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · have := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h
        positivity
      · have := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h
        positivity
    have hn' : ((c : ℂ) ^ 2 + (d : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hz : (c : ℂ) + d * Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hn'
      linear_combination ((c : ℂ) - d * Complex.I) * h0 + (d : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.I_sq
    rw [div_eq_iff hz]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    linear_combination ((a : ℂ) * d ^ 2 - (b : ℂ) * c * d) * Complex.I_sq
target_source: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I) * (c + d * Complex.I) = ((a * c - b * d : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((a * d + b * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∧ ((c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0) → ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I) / (c + d * Complex.I) = (((a * c + b * d) / (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((b * c - a * d) / (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
